status: Visual reconstructions; concealed geometry inferred. Repeated instances share a model. Names describe appearance, not new gameplay rules. Existing canonical assets preserved.
axes: +z up; original slot datum remains z=0; hull services extend below that datum; hangar opens +x. Art-reference proportions, not balanced gameplay slot sizes.

models.name: Straight space tube
models.note: Enclosed hollow station tube with matching circular coupling flanges and cyan service lights.
space_review: Replaced the open utility bridge with a circular enclosed tube; mouths remain at the original arm endpoints (16 voxels from the junction), with axis at z=9.
